notes.title: Bomber Fox 2.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, we are happy to announce the Bomber Fox 2.0 update. We want to give you much better aesthetics so you can enjoy the game even more! That's why we've spent hours and hours polishing and improving visual aspects of the game. In following update you can expect:

99% remastered graphic, new main hero model and 17 remastered skins, new maps look and a new UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36266002/f613f6d61cd13d7fd9c8397b2792dd0a466fd25c.png

New intro, outro and tutorial
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36266002/7eee7b77192c629057bc2e83f5ebc8392a4c3b23.png

We've also added game modes to VS mode for more variety of gameplay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36266002/596f2d74999a0f0fc9203e1dae9c2313256ef691.png


We hope that his update will make you enjoy Bomber Fox even more!

notes.title: The Rise of evil rabbits patch is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36266002/f62fc75d9e2effdfdb7c9f51999d12490cdb96de.jpg
Hello,
The Rise of evil rabbits patch is here and we would like to cover following changes and upgrades:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36266002/9f289def1f495c6ef20239e7162b2c96907e39e2.gif
-We have added 2 new sub campaigns with total 25 new levels. Each campaign has new challenges and game mechanics waiting for you. You can start playing sub campaign after finishing level 3 in story mode. Sub campaigns can be played solo or duo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36266002/36fb3c48700524e9ea4ae83ad5373c6ca7c18dc1.gif
-Skins rework - right now skins are more detailed and you can unlock 4 more skins in sub campaigns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36266002/271d0b058738e23a3ebb7320fe10a82fbc405d08.jpg
-Difficulty: Now you can select on what difficulty you will play. On lower difficulties you have more lives and enemies move slower. We've added difficulty mode "for kids" so even
the youngest players can have fun playing Bomber Fox :)

-Remote play together is available
-We've added a link to Discord server
